modalities.evidence: Synchronized footswitch and electrogoniometric data are provided

output.population: 31 young (20 years < age < 30 years) able-bodied subjects; underweight, overweight, obese people and those with pathological conditions, joint pain, or prior orthopedic surgery excluded
output.summary: Long-lasting surface EMG signals from ten leg muscles recorded during barefoot ground walking of young able-bodied subjects, with synchronized footswitch and electrogoniometric data for spatial and temporal gait characterization.
